verification.method: scripts/verify/econ-batch15.py reads the original World Bank zips (data/raw/wdi/), not the site's generated data; then the rendered text was read by hand
verification.what: Every figure in the direct answer, indicator cards, Key facts, story, comparison figures, table, CSV, FAQ, title, description and JSON-LD, and the claim behind each sentence (records, 'since' years, rank positions, regional comparisons, start and end years of each series, and the forest, exports and child-mortality figures quoted from other World Bank series)
verification.against: World Bank WDI bulk files and country metadata (update 11 November 2026, CC BY 4.0)
verification.result: All 3,183 automated comparisons across the five pages matched; unsourced wording was removed before publishing (Togo: a comparison with 'economies of Togo's size' and an explanation of low unemployment; Rwanda: 'three decades of rapid growth'); remittance series ending in 2023 (Senegal), 2024 (Rwanda) and 2020 (Togo) are stated on the pages

changelog.note: First version: World Bank WDI figures (update of 11 November 2026).
